title: Unique values & anagrams
hints: `slices.Compact` only removes **adjacent** duplicates. Sort first so equal values become neighbours: `out := slices.Clone(nums); slices.Sort(out); return slices.Compact(out)`.
`CountDistinct` is the same recipe on `[]string`; return `len(...)` of the compacted slice.
`r := []rune(s)` gives a fresh slice of runes; `slices.Sort(r)` then `string(r)`. Two words are anagrams exactly when `SortedLetters(a) == SortedLetters(b)`.
